terminal_reason: Cleared by its own clears_when, on main: #14127 (feb28068) scoped AlpacaClient.place_protective's pre-cancel to reducing-side legs sized to the row's qty, refusing on a same-size sibling, and #14177 made the top-up additive (cancels nothing). The two-row test is tests/test_alpaca_rearm_scoped_cancel.py::test_rearming_the_8_share_row_leaves_the_11_share_sibling_intact (SPY 8+11). Re-verified 2026-09-30 by lane ALPACA-REARM (session_01FWD56p45DUf3cUzpDiPmDA): putting the unscoped _cancel_open_orders_for_symbol back turns 10 of 14 tests in that file red.
what: Alpaca naked re-arm strips SIBLING protection. _attempt_naked_autoprotect (src/runtime/order_monitor.py) calls AlpacaClient.place_protective with the journal ROW's qty; place_protective first runs _cancel_open_orders_for_symbol(sym), which DELETEs every resting order on the symbol, then places one GTC OCO sized to that one row. On a symbol held by more than one open row the other rows' stops are cancelled and not replaced. Measured exposure 2026-09-29T10:38Z (/api/diag/alpaca_open_orders): alpaca_paper SPY carries two OCO groups (8 + 11 shares on a 19-share position) -- a true re-arm of either row would leave the other's shares naked. The quantity-coverage detector would then page partially_naked, but nothing repairs it. #14123 removes the FALSE re-arms (the dominant trigger), not this path; true re-arms (GTC 90-day expiry, day-TIF fallback) still reach it. IB already scopes its pre-cancel by oca_key (BL-20260814-IB-PROTECTION-BOOLEAN-NOT-QUANTITY); the Alpaca path ignores the oca_key it is passed.
